long_biography.plain_text:
Industry representation formed the other side of Phillip Webster's career. He was elected Fairfield-Liverpool delegate and became a metropolitan executive member of the Australian Hotels Association NSW. Over two decades on the board, he brought a working hotelier's perspective to policy and politics affecting operators across the state.

That service extended across more than thirty years of association involvement. Colleagues remembered Webster for practical judgment, wit and an ability to work with influential figures on different sides of politics. After his death, the local delegate role passed to Vicki, continuing the family's participation in the organisation.

uncertainties.detail: The source record provides no employer, biography or social links. Resolution depends on the exact private-asset dimensions and Phil/Vicky pairing in the club publication, joined to AHA NSW's Phil/Vicki sibling-business record and PubTIC's full Phillip Webster name. That multi-source bridge clears the threshold, but private-asset facts remain excluded from biographies.

The source incorrectly records Webster as alive. PubTIC reported his death in December 2022 at age 62, and AHA NSW later confirms his passing. Mortality is proposed for correction; death year and age remain dependent review candidates because the input inventory currently marks death fields inapplicable.

Sources establish that Webster's parents bought the family's pubs and that he later operated Richards on the Park with Vicki. They do not state whether his economic interest arose through inheritance, a lifetime family transfer or another arrangement, so Unknown is used rather than overclaiming a transfer mechanism.

Industry reporting calls Vicki Webster his business partner and AHA NSW documents their operating partnership. Exact shareholdings, ownership entities and succession arrangements are not public and are not inferred.

The industry obituary gives age 62 at death but no exact date of birth. No middle name, second nationality, specific birthplace or complete birth date cleared the evidence threshold, and no birth year is back-calculated from age alone.

No exact official personal LinkedIn, Instagram, personal website or other supported profile was verified for the deceased Webster. AHA NSW and Richards on the Park pages are not treated as personal profiles, and the venue was later sold.

Hotel operations is the minimum useful active tag because Australian hotelier and publican sources establish a defining long-term venue-operating mandate. Gaming machines is excluded because the reviewed evidence does not make it a distinct defining specialism for Webster.

Both biographies exclude private-vessel associations, vessel dimensions, charter transactions, valuations, later venue-sale figures, compliance matters, private medical information and unsupported family details. Nothing has been compiled, approved or applied.
